direction._help: force: null | "ltr" | "rtl". When set, every locale uses that direction (e.g. "rtl" to flip the UI even for English). When null, each locale's own `dir` is used.

auth_demo._help: Demo-only settings for the register -> verify flow. code_ttl_minutes: how long the emailed code is valid. heartbeat_*: the open verify page pings the server; if the page is closed the flow dies (rejoin_grace_seconds lets a reload through). show_code_on_page: show the 'sent' email on the verify page (turn off once real email exists). allow_unregistered_login: demo login still accepts any valid email (false = only verified registrants can log in).
